SELECT 
    MIN("Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)") AS LowestFreeRate,
    MAX("Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)") AS HighestFreeRate,
    AVG("Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)") AS AverageFreeRate

    frpm
WHERE 
    "Age Group" = '5-17';
